reference.implementation_scope: independent analytical benchmark reference; no Curve source code, tests, constants, comments, or implementation structure vendored

profile_selection_policy.training_data: eight synthetic paths x four flow regimes x two seeds x fixed and elastic routing for Curve, concentrated Dusk, and Dusk CPMM profile families; historical windows are not read
profile_selection_policy.relaxation_rule: minimum fraction t -> t*(1-rho); maximum bounded fraction t -> t+rho*(1-t); maximum cost t -> t*(1+rho); one common rho is the smallest value admitting at least one hard-valid profile from each system
profile_selection_policy.selection_utility: maximize the minimum across routes of 0.8*median fee-adjusted LP return + 0.2*p10 return; tie-break by mean route utility, lower violation, higher minimum route capture, lower maximum route p90 execution cost, profile id

cpmm_product_fallback.comparison_scope: independently selected on synthetic training under the same route-service envelope; blind held-out product comparator

cpmm_matched_policy_ablation.comparison_scope: selected current-DH2 fee and controller held fixed; only peak_depth and fade_scale set to zero

decision.rule: The selected Curve, concentrated-Dusk, and CPMM-product profiles must pass the original synthetic training service envelope before either concentrated candidate can be called a universal winner, so the common relaxation must be zero. It must also pass independently in fixed and elastic routing: >=1 bp/12h median advantage, >=70% window wins, and a bottom-decile mean >= -1 bp. Every flow-by-route cell must avoid a median return reversal. Route, flow, and matching-basis tails must keep p90 execution regression <=1 bp, p10 capture advantage >=-2 percentage points, and p90 all-in and fee-free staleness regressions <=5 percentage points. The result must also persist across parameter neighborhoods, pool scales, one-minute cadence, nearest-shape, equal-risk, and pinned v2.1 deployment-invariant matching bases. In addition, a concentrated candidate must beat the Dusk CPMM product fallback under those same route and flow-by-route return and service thresholds.

gross_outcome_for_fee_adjusted_selected_.scope: gross outcome for the profiles selected on fee-adjusted synthetic return; diagnostic only and not a gross universal-winner claim
